collection.source: Completed retained-history GitHub Actions job log, decoded with the GitHub connector.
collection.log_line_definition: One-based line number in the captured seven-day write-process output, preserved by the driver after all timed work; not a line number in the GitHub job log.
collection.scope: All checkpoint profiles, first_reveal_durable consequence profiles, and day boundaries from the seven-day synthetic write process.
collection.privacy: Timing fields and synthetic checkpoint identifiers only. No save payload, account data, runner credentials, or signed artifact URLs.
collection.interpretation_limit: Inclusive nested scopes overlap. Do not sum parent and child scopes or infer causation solely from adjacency; audit synchronous source calls before attributing a checkpoint to a first reveal.
